quantResearch.title: 高频订单流极值不平衡度与微观动量衰减预测 (Order Flow Imbalance, OFI)
quantResearch.coreHypothesis: 微观订单簿 Level-2 顶层五档挂单深度的动态失衡，在跨价位跳跃瞬态具备显著的短时非线性 Alpha 预测能力。通过将主动成交量与挂撤单增量正交分解，可有效分离被动做市库存调整与知情交易者的主买驱动。
quantResearch.mathFormula: OFI_t = \sum_{k=1}^5 \left( \Delta I_{t,k}^b \cdot \mathbb{I}_{\Delta P_t^b \ge 0} - \Delta I_{t,k}^a \cdot \mathbb{I}_{\Delta P_t^a \le 0} \right) \cdot e^{-\lambda (k-1)}
quantResearch.sampleCode:
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import vectorbt as vbt

def compute_order_flow_imbalance(bids: np.ndarray, asks: np.ndarray, window: int = 20) -> pd.Series:
    """
    计算多档挂单瞬态失衡度 OFI 因子 (Level-2 Microstructure)
    bids, asks 维度: (T, 5, 2) 分别代表 [时间, 档位, (价格, 数量)]
    """
    # 提取第 1 档最优买卖价与量
    bid_p, bid_v = bids[:, 0, 0], bids[:, 0, 1]
    ask_p, ask_v = asks[:, 0, 0], asks[:, 0, 1]
    
    delta_bid = np.where(bid_p > np.roll(bid_p, 1), bid_v, 
                np.where(bid_p == np.roll(bid_p, 1), bid_v - np.roll(bid_v, 1), 0))
    delta_ask = np.where(ask_p < np.roll(ask_p, 1), ask_v, 
                np.where(ask_p == np.roll(ask_p, 1), ask_v - np.roll(ask_v, 1), 0))
    
    # 瞬态订单流净失衡
    raw_ofi = delta_bid - delta_ask
    ofi_series = pd.Series(raw_ofi).rolling(window=window).mean()
    
    # 向量化标准化 Z-Score 信号
    signal = (ofi_series - ofi_series.rolling(60).mean()) / ofi_series.rolling(60).std()
    return signal

# 纯向量化实盘回测流水线 (VectorBT Engine)
def run_vectorized_ofi_strategy(price_series: pd.Series, ofi_signal: pd.Series):
    entries = ofi_signal > 1.5
    exits = ofi_signal < -0.5
    portfolio = vbt.Portfolio.from_signals(price_series, entries, exits, freq='15m', fees=0.0004)
    print(f"Sharpe Ratio: {portfolio.sharpe_ratio():.2f}")
    print(f"Max Drawdown: {portfolio.max_drawdown():.2%}")
    return portfolio

quantResearch.title: 跨资产协整配对与自适应卡尔曼滤波统计套利 (Kalman Cointegrated Pairs)
quantResearch.authors: Princeton Quant Lab & Nexus Alpha Team
quantResearch.factorCategory: 统计套利与相对价值 (Statistical Arbitrage)
quantResearch.coreHypothesis: 宏观同质化资产（如黄金/白银比价、Brent/WTI 原油价差、离岸人民币与 A50 股指期货）长期受供求均衡约束存在平稳协整关系。引入自适应卡尔曼滤波动态在线估计时变对冲比率 Beta_t，能大幅降低传统固定线性回归的均值漂移风险。
quantResearch.sampleCode:
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from pykalman import KalmanFilter

def run_kalman_pairs_trading(asset_y: pd.Series, asset_x: pd.Series):
    """
    自适应时变对冲比率卡尔曼滤波配对套利 (Kalman Filter Cointegration)
    """
    obs_mat = np.vstack([asset_x.values, np.ones(len(asset_x))]).T[:, np.newaxis, :]
    
    # 初始化状态空间自适应平滑器
    kf = KalmanFilter(n_dim_obs=1, n_dim_state=2, 
                      initial_state_mean=np.zeros(2),
                      initial_state_covariance=np.ones((2, 2)),
                      transition_matrices=np.eye(2),
                      observation_matrices=obs_mat,
                      observation_covariance=1.0,
                      transition_covariance=1e-5 * np.eye(2))
    
    state_means, _ = kf.filter(asset_y.values)
    beta_series = state_means[:, 0]
    alpha_series = state_means[:, 1]
    
    # 动态残差价差 (Spread Residuals)
    residuals = asset_y.values - (beta_series * asset_x.values + alpha_series)
    z_score = (residuals - pd.Series(residuals).rolling(30).mean()) / pd.Series(residuals).rolling(30).std()
    
    # 生成配对多空仓位权重
    long_spread = z_score < -2.0
    short_spread = z_score > 2.0
    exit_spread = np.abs(z_score) < 0.2
    return beta_series, z_score, long_spread, short_spread, exit_spread

quantResearch.title: 深度强化学习自适应 TWAP/VWAP 订单执行算法 (PPO Dynamic Execution)
quantResearch.authors: Oxford MAN Institute & Nexus Applied AI
quantResearch.factorCategory: 微观执行与滑点抑制 (Algorithmic Execution)
quantResearch.coreHypothesis: 传统机械性 TWAP/VWAP 算法在盘口成交量骤降时极易被高频做市商前置捕食（Front-running）。构建基于 Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) 的动态订单分拆智能体，根据瞬态市场冲击成本曲线自适应调整子单下达节奏，实盘验证可挽回 14.8 bps 冲击滑点。
quantResearch.sampleCode:
import torch
import torch.nn as nn

class PPOExecutionPolicy(nn.Module):
    """
    PPO 连续动作空间执行策略网络：输出当前时间片的切片挂单比例比例 alpha_t
    状态输入: [已执行比例, 剩余时间, 盘口买卖失衡度 OFI, 瞬态波动率, 相对挂单量]
    """
    def __init__(self, state_dim: int = 5, action_dim: int = 1):
        super().__init__()
        self.backbone = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(state_dim, 128),
            nn.LayerNorm(128),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(128, 64),
            nn.GELU()
        )
        self.actor_mu = nn.Linear(64, action_dim)
        self.actor_std = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(action_dim))
        self.critic = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        
    def forward(self, state: torch.Tensor):
        features = self.backbone(state)
        action_mean = torch.sigmoid(self.actor_mu(features)) # 映射至 [0, 1] 比例
        value = self.critic(features)
        return action_mean, torch.exp(self.actor_std), value
